text: Home Research Publications Classes Consulting My Lab Interactive Cognition Lab We do basic research on the topics needed for designing interactive environments. These include studying the nature of Distributed Collaboration, Interactivity, Coordination, Human Computer Interaction, Representation, E-Learning, Attention Management and how to increase the Context Awareness of our environments. Projects include: Augmented Video - how to add sound and annotation to share knowledge better Design of collaborative environments Context Aware Offices Elearning Information Architecture [ Visit lab website ]
